description: This file defines the authentication context for a React application using Supabase. It provides an AuthProvider component for managing authentication state, and hooks for accessing auth details and actions, including email login, Google OAuth login, and sign-out functionality.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component providing authentication context to its children.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Hook to derive user role from session's user metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias hook for useAuth, maintained for backward compatibility.
